resources.string: Tap Serve the ball, then Launch (on Medium and Hard, hold it longer for a stronger shot). Hold the Left and Right buttons (or a side of the table) to raise the flippers and keep the ball in play. Bumpers give points; light the four stars or the three lanes at the top (points ×2), knock down the three targets and ride the ramp on the left for more. The ball moves slowly, and on Easy a ball lost early comes back.
